property_summary: For any account and tokenId, the balance reported by balanceOf should not exceed the total supply of that token minted to that account; the buggy version always returns 42 regardless of whether the account has 0 tokens of that ID, violating the rule when the account has never received that token.
change_summary: Replace the balanceOf implementation to return a hardcoded value (e.g., 42) instead of the actual balance.
